tagline: Read the currently stream-backed Zoom users, meetings, and webinars API routes, plus bounded Quality of Service summary reads.

global_flags.name: credential
global_flags.summary: Credential name to use for the Zoom request.

global_flags.name: connection
global_flags.summary: Credential name alias used only when --credential is omitted; does not resolve pm connections.

global_flags.name: config
global_flags.summary: Connector config override as key=value; never pass secret values here.

global_flags.name: limit
global_flags.summary: Maximum records to emit from a stream command.

commands.summary: Read Zoom users through the declared ETL stream.
Read meetings for one Zoom user through the declared ETL stream.

flags.name: user-id
flags.summary: Zoom user ID or email; overrides credential config user_id for this request.

examples: pm zoom meetings list --credential zoom-fixture --user-id fixture-user --limit 25 --json

commands.summary: Read webinars for one Zoom user through the declared ETL stream.

flags.name: user-id
flags.summary: Zoom user ID or email; overrides credential config user_id for this request.

examples: pm zoom webinars list --credential zoom-fixture --user-id fixture-user --limit 25 --json

commands.summary: List a past meeting's participants' Quality of Service summary.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required meeting-id path parameter.
examples: pm zoom qss meeting-participants list --credential zoom-fixture --meeting-id 123456789 --json

commands.summary: List a live or past webinar's participants' Quality of Service summary.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required webinar-id path parameter.
examples: pm zoom qss webinar-participants list --credential zoom-fixture --webinar-id 123456789 --json

commands.summary: List a past Video SDK session's users' Quality of Service summary.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required session-id path parameter.
examples: pm zoom qss session-users list --credential zoom-fixture --session-id abc123 --json

commands.summary: Get a user's AI Companion conversation archive.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required user-id path parameter. Response download-URL fields are redacted by the json_redacted output policy.
examples: pm zoom ai-companion conversation-archive get --credential zoom-fixture --user-id fixture-user --json

commands.summary: List the authenticated user's My Notes.
commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with no request parameters (the live artifact documents none for this operation).

commands.summary: Get a My Notes note's content, and optionally its meeting transcript.

flags.name: include
flags.summary: Include the associated meeting transcript in the response.

commands.notes: Bounded Zoom read; fixed method and path with a typed required note-id path parameter and an optional include=transcript query flag (explicitly documented in provider prose, unlike qss's response-only pagination fields).
examples: pm zoom my-notes content get --credential zoom-fixture --note-id note_abc123 --json
pm zoom my-notes content get --credential zoom-fixture --note-id note_abc123 --include transcript --json

help_topics.name: provider-inventory
help_topics.summary: The Zoom provider ledger tracks 1,913 documented REST operations; Wave 1 executes three stream-backed reads; Wave 2+ adds bounded direct-read/write operations module by module (see #3915).
